title: Bulk Generation
description: Generate thousands of QR codes at once with bulk jobs. Submit an array of QR code definitions and receive a job ID to track progress.

sections.title: How it works
items: Submit a bulk job with an array of QR code definitions (up to 1,000 on Pro, 10,000 on Business/Enterprise)
Poll the job status endpoint until status is done
Download a ZIP file containing all QR code images (valid for 24 hours)
